sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Ravi Prakash Singh
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.G.A. for the State -respondent.

2. The instant writ petition has been filed to quash the impugned F.I.R. dated 12.11.2022 lodged by
the respondent no. 4 as Case Crime No. 0397 of 2022, under Section 323, 307, 498A, 506 I.P.C. and
section D.P. Act, P.S. Jaithra, Etah, District Etah.
Nitin Gupta @ Sainki And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 11 December, 2024

Today when the matter is taken up, learned counsel for the petitioner at the very outset submits that the cause of filing the instant writ petition no more survive, as the charge-sheet has already been forwarded to the competent court, hence the petition may be dismissed as not pressed with liberty to apply before the competent court for anticipatory bail/bail or to press an application under section 482 Cr.P.C./Section 528 of B.N.S.S., 2023.
4.
In view of the statement made above, the instant writ petition is dismissed as not pressed with liberty as prayed for.

Order Date :- 11.12.2024 Bhanu  Nitin Gupta @ Sainki And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91694766/
